Patriarchy has no place in progressive India: Lakshmi Venu as TVS family heads for partition 
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone Patriarchy has no place in progressive India: Lakshmi Venu as TVS family heads for partition
 short by Ashley Paul / 03:30 pm on Monday, 16 November 2026 TAFE Vice Chairman Lakshmi Venu opposed her father and brother, TVS Motor Chairman Emeritus Venu Srinivasan and MD Sudarshan Venu, as the TVS family heads for a partition. "Patriarchy has no place in law or in a progressive India," Lakshmi's notice seeking formal partition said. "The rights of daughters to joint family property...cannot be overridden through unilateral decisions," it added. read more at Moneycontrol Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
